outcome: Key secondary end point: SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid antibody–positive at median 6-moth follow-up

citations.text: Full details of the trial conduct are provided in the protocol (which includes the statistical analysis plan), available with the full text of this article at NEJM.org.
(Funded by AstraZeneca and the U.S. government; PROVENT ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT04625725.)

The primary efficacy end point was the first episode of symptomatic Covid-19, confirmed by positive results on reverse-transcriptase–polymerase-chain-reaction (RT-PCR) testing, with an onset after the administration of AZD7442 or placebo and on or before day 183.
